summary: The root نِحْلَةٌ (niḥlah) refers to an obligation or a religious belief/creed. It's used to ask about someone's religion, as in "What is your religion?"
lane: نِحْلَةٌ ذ i. q. فَرِيضَةٌ ; or دِيَانَةٌ ; and دِينٌ , as in the saying مَا نِحْلَتُكَ [ What is thy religion? ]. (TA.)
